2117550199895896490.en_summary: Counterpoint on $MRVL / $LITE acquisition: every buyer competing with Marvell will want second independent laser source. $SIVE / Scintil as new capacity, $CRDO potential partner. Lumentum sold out, overflow to merchant capacity. $JBL competing upstream, $SMTC doing M&A for lasers. AI crash not representative of optical sector strength; laser bottleneck opportunities mispriced.
2117550199895896490.zh_summary: 對 $MRVL / $LITE 收購的反觀點：與 Marvell 競爭的買家都想要第二個獨立激光源。$SIVE / Scintil 作為新產能，$CRDO 潛在合作夥伴。Lumentum 已售罄，溢出給商用產能。$JBL 上游競爭，$SMTC 透過併購擴展激光產能。AI 崩跌不代表光學板塊實力；激光瓶頸機會被錯誤定價。

2117539121434591711.en_summary: AI names crashed so much $POET business considered close to worthless. $829.7M MC vs ~$788M net cash, below $847.5M book value. Institutions funded at $21 few months ago, now ~$4.8. Needs +337.5% to return to financing price. FOGO extreme if growth companies priced near liquidation.
2117539121434591711.zh_summary: AI 股票崩跌至 $POET 業務被視為幾乎無價值。市值 8.297 億對淨現金約 7.88 億，低於 8.475 億帳面價值。數月前機構以 21 美元融資，現約 4.8 美元。需上漲 337.5% 才回到融資價。若成長公司定價接近清算價值，則 FOGO 極端。

2117493886100918684.en_summary: Markets trolling with $ESMT ($2.3B MC) memory earnings: Revenue $679.4M, GP $526.2M (77.44%), OP $403.4M (59.37%). Annualized Q3 $1.61B OP. $757M net cash + $278M inventory. ~3.5x more quarters to exceed MC in assets. No meaningful DDR2/3 supply increase expected 2027, prices maintained. 1.59x p/e annualized, further hikes Q4.
2117493886100918684.zh_summary: 市場在嘲弄 $ESMT（市值 23 億）記憶體業績：營收 6.794 億，毛利 5.262 億（77.44%），營業利潤 4.034 億（59.37%）。年化 Q3 營業利潤 16.1 億。淨現金 7.57 億 + 庫存 2.78 億。約再 3.5 季資產超過市值。2027 年不預期 DDR2/3 供應大幅增加，價格可維持。年化 1.59 倍市盈率，Q4 進一步漲價。
